content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the TISS Various Posts Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 09-11-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of TISS to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the conducting body for TISS Non-Teaching Positions Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The Tata Institute of Social Sciences (TISS) is conducting the recruitment drive for various non-teaching positions across its campuses to fill a total of 16 vacancies under advertisement number TISS/NON-TEACHING POSITIONS/2026/02.

faq.question: Q2. How many total vacancies are announced in this notification?
faq.answer: A total of 16 vacancies have been announced for various non-teaching roles including Deputy Registrar, Deputy Librarian, Assistant Registrar, Section Officer, Counsellor, and other administrative and technical positions.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to submit the online application form?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application form for TISS Non-Teaching recruitment is 9 November 2026. Candidates must ensure they complete their submissions well before the deadline to avoid any technical glitches.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required for Deputy Registrar posts?
faq.answer: Candidates applying for the Deputy Registrar position must possess a Master's Degree with at least 55% marks or an equivalent grade along with relevant administrative or teaching experience as prescribed in the official notification.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for submitting the form?
faq.answer: Yes, the application fee varies by category. UR candidates pay Rs. 2,000/-, OBC/EWS and women candidates pay Rs. 1,500/-, SC/ST candidates pay Rs. 1,000/-, and PwBD category candidates are required to pay Rs. 500/-.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection process comprises online application submission, screening committee shortlisting based on qualifications and experience, a written test or interview depending on the post, and final document verification.

faq.question: Q7. Can I apply for multiple posts through a single application?
faq.answer: No, candidates must submit a separate application form and pay the respective application fee for each post they wish to apply for if they are applying for multiple designations.

faq.question: Q8. What is the salary range offered for these non-teaching positions?
faq.answer: The selected candidates will be placed in various pay scales ranging from Pay Level 7 to Level 12 (including Academic Levels 10 and 12) corresponding to the specific post applied for as per the 7th CPC guidelines.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I find the official website to apply online?
faq.answer: Candidates can visit the official Tata Institute of Social Sciences website at www.tiss.ac.in to access the online application portal, read detailed guidelines, and download the official notification PDF.

faq.question: Q10. Are there any specific age limits for applying to these positions?
faq.answer: Yes, maximum age limits range from 40 to 50 years depending on the specific post (e.g., 50 years for Deputy Registrar and Deputy Librarian, and 40-45 years for other administrative and professional roles).
